name: Jefferson Stumpers
description: The Jefferson Stumpers were a Black street gang based in Brooklyn, New York, active during the 1960s. They were rivals of the Halsey Street Bops, a white gang from Bushwick, and were associated in gang histories alongside the Junior Sinners. Their name appears to derive from Jefferson Street, the area of their turf. The 81st Precinct (Bushwick) recorded incidents tied to their conflict with the Halsey Bops.
